title: Sitecore to Strapi: headless content architecture
subtitle: Life insurance client · Publicis Sapient
summary: Content architecture for a Sitecore-to-Strapi migration, defining the information architecture, structured content model and reusable templates and components.

artwork.alt: Neon pink connected content blocks representing structured content architecture.

facts.label: Client
facts.value: Life insurance client, via Publicis Sapient

facts.label: Output
facts.value: Sitemap, information architecture, content model, taxonomy and tagging strategy, template and component structure

story.label: Context
story.title: Moving to a headless CMS
story.body: A life insurance client was migrating from Sitecore to Strapi and needed a content architecture that could support a scalable website.

story.label: My role
story.title: Shaping the structure behind the site
story.body: As Content Architect, I worked with the marketing lead to define the sitemap, information architecture, content model, taxonomy and tagging strategy. I partnered with UX and developers to translate these into reusable templates and components.

story.label: Outcome
story.title: A scalable foundation in Strapi
story.body: The result was a website powered by a headless CMS, with structured content and reusable components designed to support future growth.

title: The Maybourne Library: DAM implementation
subtitle: Maybourne · Bynder
summary: Bynder implementation and automated migration of 8,000+ assets, supported by asset classification, taxonomy and team onboarding.

artwork.alt: Neon pink stacked image cards and a tag representing a digital asset library.

facts.label: Output
facts.value: Classification of 8,000+ assets, taxonomy, automated migration, onboarding and change management

story.label: Context
story.title: Building The Maybourne Library
story.body: Maybourne needed a digital asset management platform to bring more than 8,000 assets into a shared, structured library.

story.label: My role
story.title: Making the library work for its teams
story.body: My work covered Bynder implementation, asset classification, taxonomy and automated migration. I also supported user onboarding and change management to help teams adopt The Maybourne Library.

story.label: Outcome
story.title: A connected asset library
story.body: The Maybourne Library launched successfully, with assets migrated into Bynder and integrations connecting the DAM to CMS and CRM systems.

title: From annual reports to structured content
subtitle: Insurance client · Foolproof
summary: Content and domain modelling in Sanity to support automated annual report production and a scalable reporting workflow.

artwork.alt: Neon pink report page and circular arrows representing automated reporting.

facts.label: Output
facts.value: Domain model, content model, operational processes and user training

story.label: Context
story.title: Rethinking annual report production
story.body: An insurance client wanted to automate annual print reports and improve the processes behind them, using a CMS and management portal to support production at scale.

story.label: My role
story.title: Modelling the content and how it moves
story.body: I worked across domain modelling, content modelling, content architecture and content operations, defining how report content would be structured and managed in Sanity and the wider reporting workflow.

story.label: Outcome
story.title: A live reporting portal
story.body: Sanity was successfully implemented, users were trained and the portal went live to enable the creation of client reports.
